about.title: Social growth without complications
about.intro: We are building a clear experience for creators, businesses and agencies that need to move forward without wasting time.
about.proofText: Less technical language, better navigation and decisions with visible information.
about.purposeTitle: Make simple what others make confusing
about.text: ImpulsoSocial was created to turn a technical service panel into an easy-to-understand storefront. We organize the experience around your goals, not provider processes.
about.secondText: The platform is built in stages and only shows real capabilities. When something is not available yet, we communicate it directly.

clarity.title: Clarity
clarity.text: Useful information, visible prices and understandable states.

honesty.title: Honesty
honesty.text: No guaranteed promises, invented figures or simulated actions.

flexibility.title: Flexibility
flexibility.text: Brand, colors, languages and offering configurable for every tenant.

about.ctaText: Explore the categories available for this first release.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Direct answers about the catalog, accounts and features that will be enabled in stages.
faq.asideText: Start by reviewing the available Instagram categories.

explore.question: Can I explore before registering?
explore.answer: Yes. Public navigation and categories can be reviewed without creating an account.

networks.question: Which networks are available?
networks.answer: Instagram is the only network enabled in this first release.

results.question: Are results guaranteed?
results.answer: No. We provide clear information without promising guaranteed results.

purchase.question: Can I buy from the site now?
purchase.answer: Purchasing will be enabled once the catalog and order workflow are completely connected in the frontend.

payments.question: Which payment methods will be available?
payments.answer: The storefront displays the methods configured by the tenant and only enables options with an available flow.

customization.question: Can I change the language or theme?
customization.answer: Yes. You can use Spanish or English, choose dark, light or system mode, and switch between four visual styles.
